topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a piece of paper tucked away in a book on the top shelf. At first, I thought it was just a bookmark, but as I unfolded it, I saw it was more than that. It was Alex's bucket list. Things like "Learn to skydive," "Visit Tokyo," and "Write a novel" were jotted down, each item more intriguing than the last. I never knew they wanted to write a book. Now I'm wondering how many of these dreams we could chase together. Maybe I'll bring it up over dinner tonight, see where this leads.
